component.name: CharSheet
component.summary: Build, track and play D&D 5e (2024) characters

description.p: A character sheet for Dungeons & Dragons fifth edition (2024 rules) that does the math for you. Enter ability scores, classes and gear, and the sheet works out modifiers, saving throws, skills, armor class, initiative, attacks, spell save DC and spell slots, and shows where every number comes from.

ul.li: Click any modifier to roll it, with 3D dice that land on the result and a roll log that breaks each total down by source and damage type
A Combat tab with the round counter, active effects and concentration, and every action grouped by Action, Bonus Action and Reaction
Items, features and spells carry modifiers and actions: damage riders, toggles, ammunition, reloading, charges and healing
The whole SRD 5.2.1 built in: add spells, items and features from the compendium with their stats and rules text
Track hit points, hit dice, death saves, spell slots, feature uses, conditions and Exhaustion, with short and long rests that restore the right resources
Multiclassing, Pact Magic and Weapon Mastery
Themes styled after the 2024 character sheet and the Player's Handbook, or your desktop colors
An MCP server so an AI assistant can read, edit and play your characters
